+def _split_segments_on_newline(segments: Iterable[Segment]) -> Iterable[Segment]:
+    """Split text segments containing newlines so that each line is a separate segment.
+
+    This allows a style to be applied to each line independently (newlines are unstyled).
+    """
+    for segment in segments:
+        text, style, control = segment
+        if control or "\n" not in text:
+            yield segment
+            continue
+        lines = text.split("\n")
+        for index, line in enumerate(lines):
+            if index:
+                yield Segment.line()
+            if line:
+                yield Segment(line, style)
+
